title: CheXPoT: Post-Hoc Visual Verification and Correction of VLM-Generated Radiology Reports
abstract: arXiv:2611.00785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise for chest radiograph report generation, but adoption remains limited because of hallucinated findings that are not grounded in the image. Correcting these hallucinations and improving overall report quality remains a significant challenge. Prior work has addressed this problem by refining models with reinforcement learning, preference optimization, or chain-of-thought supervision, often at substantial compute cost. To address this gap, we introduce CheXPoT, a program-of-thought (PoT) framework that verifies each generated finding against image features and removes those it cannot ground. CheXPoT decomposes generated reports into predicates with RadGraph and an LLM, grounds these predicates against a DenseNet-121 and Grad-CAM visual evidence table, executes PoT verification code, and rewrites reports after removing unsupported predicates. translated_title: CheXPoT：对视觉语言模型生成的放射报告进行事后视觉验证与修正
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在胸部X光片报告生成方面展现出巨大潜力，但由于其生成的发现中包含与图像不符的幻觉内容，实际应用仍然受限。纠正这些幻觉并提升整体报告质量仍是一项重大挑战。以往的工作通常通过强化学习、偏好优化或思维链监督来精调模型以解决该问题，但往往需要巨大的计算成本。为填补这一空白，我们提出了CheXPoT，一个程序化思维框架，它将生成的每一条发现与图像特征进行核对验证，并删除无法在图像中找到依据的发现。CheXPoT利用RadGraph和大语言模型将生成的报告分解为谓词，将这些谓词与基于DenseNet-121和Grad-CAM构建的视觉证据表进行对齐，执行PoT验证代码，并在删除缺乏图像支撑的谓词后重写报告。在一个包含4,145张图像的保留测试集上，CheXPoT取得了显著的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CheXPoT提出了一种程序化思维框架，将视觉语言模型生成的放射报告分解为谓词并与视觉证据逐一比对验证，事后删除无法在图像中找到依据的幻觉性发现，从而以远低于训练类方法的计算成本提升报告质量。
